title: Higher National Diploma in Early Childhood Education and care
description: The Higher National Diploma in Early Childhood Education and Care equips learners with the knowledge, practical skills, and professional competencies to support the holistic development, learning, and well-being of young children in diverse early years settings.
longDescription: The Higher National Diploma in Early Childhood Education and Care provides comprehensive knowledge of child development, early learning theories, and effective childcare practices. The programme prepares learners to create safe, inclusive, and stimulating environments that foster children's physical, emotional, social, and cognitive development. Students gain practical experience in curriculum planning, safeguarding, family engagement, and leadership within early years settings. Graduates are equipped for careers in nurseries, preschools, childcare centres, and further academic progression.
courseDetails: The Higher National Diploma in Early Childhood Education and Care provides comprehensive knowledge of child development, early learning theories, and effective childcare practices. The programme prepares learners to create safe, inclusive, and stimulating environments that foster children's physical, emotional, social, and cognitive development. Students gain practical experience in curriculum planning, safeguarding, family engagement, and leadership within early years settings. Graduates are equipped for careers in nurseries, preschools, childcare centres, and further academic progression. LO1: Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of child development theories and their application in early childhood education and care. LO2: Design and implement inclusive, developmentally appropriate learning experiences that promote children's holistic growth and well-being. LO3: Apply safeguarding, health, safety, and child protection principles to ensure secure and nurturing early learning environments. LO4: Collaborate effectively with families, communities, and multidisciplinary professionals to support children's learning and development. LO5: Evaluate early childhood policies, ethical practices, and leadership approaches to enhance the quality of education and care services. LO6: Reflect critically on professional practice, applying research-informed strategies to promote continuous improvement in early childhood education and care.

entry: For entry into Extended Level 5 Diploma in Care Giver, learners must possess the following:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Result can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Result. (This is assessed on a case by case basis)
* Learner must be 18 years or older at the start of the Course.
* Mature Learners (21 years or older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
